safety: regenerate bad embedded text rather than bitmap patching
exclude credentials private content and unlicensed assets

layout_policy.topology_rule: regions, containers, nodes, labels, and connectors follow actual semantic content and relationships
layout_policy.container_rule: a container exists only when it has corresponding content or a documented grouping role
layout_policy.safe_area_rule: content remains inside intended regions and connectors attach to intended ports without clipping or collision

reliability: one active image job by default; raise to two only after current-task health check
